wiktionary.gloss: To cut (something) with a saw.
To make a motion back and forth similar to cutting something with a saw.

idioms.phrase: saw off the branch one is sitting on

idioms.gloss: To cut into boards using parallel cuts that are tangential to the growth rings.

To cut a log into boards by first quartering and then cutting radially at an angle of 30-60 degrees to the grain (as opposed to quartersaw, which involves cutting radially at an angle of 60-90 degrees).
Synonym of if ever there was one.

known: saw off the branch one is sitting on
